__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: The Prometheus that scrapes grad-server's and the workers' /metrics.

__inputs.name: DS_LOKI
__inputs.label: Loki
__inputs.description: The Loki with the grad pods' logs (optional: only the Logs section uses it).

title: grad / Training platform
description: grad-server, its job queue and workers: one section per question. Cloud-only sections (Billing, Cloud auth) stay empty on self-hosted servers.

panels.title: API replicas
panels.description: grad-server replicas Prometheus scrapes (0: down, or the scrape is broken).

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of API requests answered with a 5xx.

panels.title: Jobs waiting
panels.description: Claimable queued jobs, plus runs waiting for a GPU that fits.

panels.title: Failed jobs (1h)
panels.description: Failed jobs over finished jobs in the last hour.

panels.title: Last tick
panels.description: Seconds since the maintenance loop (lease expiry, gauges, usage, syncs) last finished a tick; it runs every 15 s.

panels.title: Jobs by kind and state
panels.description: Open jobs. kind: train, import (uploads and Hugging Face imports), sync (source syncs) or eval. blocked: waiting on another job; waiting_for_compute: no online worker has a GPU that fits.

panels.title: Open jobs (KEDA's target)
panels.description: Claimable queued plus leased jobs per kind, minus those held back by their workspace's running cap.

panels.title: Fair share: wait and capped jobs
panels.description: Longest wait of a workspace's next job (workspaces below their running cap), and jobs held back by GRAD_MAX_RUNNING_PER_WORKSPACE_*.

panels.title: Rejected creates (429 queue_limit) and unfit runs
panels.description: Creates refused because a workspace hit GRAD_MAX_QUEUED_PER_WORKSPACE, and queued runs no online GPU can fit.

panels.title: Jobs finished by kind and status
Failures by kind, recipe and error code
panels.description: attempts_exhausted: max_attempts attempts ended without a result (crashes, OOM, lost workers); preemptions_exhausted: compute reclaimed too often; invalid_artifact / source_unavailable: artifact imports; job_error: the worker reported the failure.

panels.title: Run duration by recipe (p50, p95)
panels.description: Creation to terminal status, queue wait included.

panels.title: Attempts started and interrupted
panels.description: Interruptions by reason: compute_reclaimed (preemption, handed back), lease_lost (lease expired: a lost worker), worker_error, oom.

panels.title: Reclaims and emergency checkpoints
panels.description: Train attempts handed back because compute was reclaimed, the emergency checkpoints that made it in, and those workers failed to save (grad_trainer_*: scraped workers only).

panels.title: Lease expiries and fencing rejections
panels.description: Leases the reaper expired, and worker writes refused because the attempt's lease is gone or bound elsewhere (409 lease_lost, 403 worker_host_mismatch).

panels.title: Usage flush lag
panels.description: Longest a running attempt has gone without writing usage (a stalled worker or failing billing writes).

panels.title: Workers online by kind
panels.description: Workers holding an unexpired lease (server view).

panels.title: Worker pods ready by pool
panels.description: Kubernetes only (kube-state-metrics).

panels.title: Training throughput (tokens/s)
panels.description: Server-counted from usage, by recipe, and the sum workers last reported.

panels.title: Step time (p50, p95)
panels.description: Time between training steps (scraped workers).

panels.title: GPU utilisation
panels.description: Per GPU from NVML on scraped workers; the server's mean over heartbeats otherwise. Install NVIDIA's dcgm-exporter for SM occupancy, temperatures and XID errors.

panels.title: Checkpoints by reason and result
panels.description: Registered checkpoints (server) and those scraped workers failed to save.

panels.title: Worker jobs finished by status
panels.description: Attempts scraped workers finished, by kind and status.

panels.title: Inference errors by reason
panels.description: Failed model and judge calls after retries: rate_limited (429 from the gateway's eval lane), capacity_unavailable (no serving capacity, e.g. a pool waking from zero), timeout, unreachable, server_error, rejected (4xx), malformed.

panels.title: Syncs finished by provider and status
Sync lag by provider
panels.description: Longest an active scheduled source has gone without a successful sync.

panels.title: Failing and paused sources
panels.description: Most consecutive failed syncs of any source, and sources paused after repeated failures.

panels.title: Usage push lag and backlog
panels.description: Cloud: age of the oldest ledger row not yet pushed to billing, and the rows waiting.

panels.title: Balance checks by op and result
panels.description: start: a new run or eval (refused: 402-style insufficient balance); continue: a running job's heartbeat (refused: the job stops as stopped_balance). Errors never stop running work.

panels.title: Balance stops
panels.description: Runs that stopped because the workspace ran out of balance.

panels.title: Price list age
panels.description: Cloud: since the price list was last confirmed; past 24 h new runs and evals are refused (503 billing_unavailable).

panels.title: Worker auth by mode and result
panels.description: Worker-protocol requests: mode static, kubernetes (TokenReview) or lease; none = no worker credential (rejected).

panels.title: TokenReviews by result
panels.description: saturated: refused because 8 reviews were already in flight on the replica (503 worker_auth_unavailable).

panels.title: Credential cache hit ratio
panels.description: cloud_key: the Cloud API-key cache (5 s); kubernetes: reviewed service-account tokens (60 s).

panels.title: Auth errors by code
panels.description: 401/403/503 answers about credentials: unauthorized, forbidden (scope), auth_unavailable (Cloud auth view down), worker_auth_unavailable, workspace_suspended, ...

panels.title: Errors by code
panels.description: Every problem+json error response by its code.

panels.title: Open SSE streams
panels.description: Run event and metric streams per replica; a replica whose event hub isn't LISTENing falls back to the safety poll.

panels.title: Postgres pool
panels.description: Connections per state; waiting > 0 means requests queue for a connection.

panels.title: grad-server memory
panels.description: Resident memory per API replica.

targets.expr: max by (pod) (process_resident_memory_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace"} and on (pod, instance) grad_build_info{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: Needs a Loki data source with the grad pods' logs (labels namespace and container).

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: JSON lines with level warn or error; each carries request_id, job_id, workspace_id and trace_id where they apply, and errors their stack.
